item.title: I voted
item.description: I voted in my first presidential election at the age of 18. My birthday that year fell ten days before our high school graduation.

item.title: Marion Police, Metro to hold First Aid & CPR training Saturday
item.description: Cardiac emergencies can happen to anyone at any time and anywhere, but those who receive prompt Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation, more commonly known as CPR, are much more likely to recover.

item.title: Primary absentee voting deadline two weeks out
item.description: Lauderdale County residents who will be unable to make it to their voting precinct on March 10 have just two weeks remaining to cast their votes via absentee ballot for the 2026 primary elections.

item.title: Second quarter surge sparks Meridian past Jones, 74-61
item.description: ELLISVILLE – Meridian used a 15-2 run over the final part of the second quarter and went on to defeat Jones College 74-61 here Monday night at A.B. Howard Gymnasium. […]

item.title: Mississippi Children’s Museum-Meridian to host Dr. Seuss’ Silly Birthday Celebration
item.description: Families are invited to celebrate reading, creativity and playful learning at Dr. Seuss’ Silly Birthday Celebration at Mississippi Children’s Museum – Meridian on Saturday, Feb. 28, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

item.title: MCC to induct alumni into Hall of Fame, celebrating excellence and legacy
item.description: Meridian Community College alumni who have excelled in their respective professions and life missions and have elevated MCC's esteem through their achievements, service and association with the institution will be inducted into College’s Hall of Fame on Wednesday, March 4.

item.title: MCC nursing program posts 92% pass rate on RN exam
item.description: Meridian Community College’s Associate Degree Nursing Program continues to set the standard for excellence in Mississippi.

item.title: Northeast Elementary celebrates Black History with Legacies in Motion
item.description: Students at Northeast Lauderdale Elementary School celebrated Black History through the lens of music and dance Tuesday as the fourth grade class performed for their peers, parents and school officials in a special production called Legacies in Motion.

item.title: First State Bank welcomes Hurd and Skinner to Quitman branch
item.description: First State Bank has expanded its lending team in Quitman with the addition of Stephanie Hurd as assistant vice president and branch manager and Lowery Skinner as consumer lender.
